By our povver.''] When the Apo{{ls}}tles remit {{ls}}innes, or doe any other miracles, they doe it not by any humane, proper, or natural povver in them {{ls}}elues: but of {{ls}}upernatural force giuen them from aboue, to proue that the faith of Chri{{ls}}t is true, and that he is God whom the Iewes crucified, in who{{ls}}e name and faith they worke, and not in their owne.

{{c|''The Rulers of the Iewes oppo{{ls}}e them {{ls}}elues and impri{{ls}}on Peter and Iohn. 4 But yet thou{{ls}}ands of the people are conuerted: 5 and to the Rulers al{{ls}}o, Peter boldly auoucheth by the for{{ls}}aid miracle, that IESVS is Chri{{ls}}t, telling them of their heinous fault out of the P{{ls}}almes, and that vvithout him they can not be {{ls}}aued. 13 They though confounded vvith the miracle, yet procede in their ob{{ls}}tinacie, forbidding them to {{ls}}peake any more of IESVS, adding al{{ls}}o threates. 23 Wherevpon the Church fleeth to praier, vvherein they comfort them {{ls}}elues vvith the omnipotencie of God, and prediction of Dauid, and a{{ls}}ke for the gift of boldnes and miracles again{{ls}}t tho{{ls}}e threates. 31 And God {{ls}}hevveth miraculou{{ls}}ly that he hath heard their praier. 32 The vvhole Churches vnitie and communitie of life. 36 Of Barnabas by name.''}} {{dropinitial|A|image=Rhemes New Testament 1582 initial A, two satyrs.png|imgsize=185px|fl={{verse|chapter=4|verse=1}}}}ND vvhen they vvere {{ls}}peaking to the people, the Prie{{ls}}ts and magi{{ls}}trates of the temple and the Sadducees came vpon them, {{verse|chapter=4|verse=2}} being greeued that they taught the people, and {{ls}}hevved in {{sc|Iesvs}} the re{{ls}}urrection from the dead: {{verse|chapter=4|verse=3}} and they laid handes vpon them, and put them into vvard, vntil the morovv, for it vvas novv euening. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=4}} And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ Here againe vve {{ls}}ee the proceeding and increa{{ls}}e of the Church vi{{ls}}ibly.}}∷ many of them that had heard the vvord, beleeued: and the number of the men vvas made fiue thou{{ls}}and.<noinclude>{{rh|||And}}</noinclude>
